name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that provisions an Apache HTTPS Hello World site, including packages, self-signed TLS certificates, virtual host configuration, website content, and service activation.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible playbook that hardens Apache SSL protocols toward TLS 1.2 and restarts affected services after configuration changes.

name: Chef InSpec SSH compliance profile
description: A Chef InSpec compliance profile that verifies SSH root login is disabled and inspects the OpenSSH server configuration and package.

name: website_https_verify
description: A Chef InSpec verification profile that tests HTTPS availability, expected page content, certificate behavior, and supported TLS protocols.

name: Chef Automate bootstrap
description: A Chef platform bootstrap script that configures host settings, deploys Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, and provisions users, organizations, and PEM credentials.

name: Chef Infra Server bootstrap
description: A Chef Infra Server bootstrap script that tunes the host, deploys the server, and provisions users, organizations, and generated PEM credentials.
